title: Small edits
intro: Normal mode edits without ever entering Insert mode: x deletes a character, r replaces one, dd deletes a line, u undoes, p puts back.

levels.title: Typo
levels.brief: There is one l too many. Move onto an l and press x to delete the character under the cursor.
levels.hint: Any of the three l characters works.

levels.title: Wrong letter
levels.brief: Turn cat into bat. r followed by a character replaces the character under the cursor.
levels.hint: r does not enter Insert mode. It takes exactly one character.

levels.title: Drop a line
levels.brief: Delete the middle line. dd deletes the whole line the cursor is on.

levels.title: Undo
levels.brief: A character was just deleted by mistake. Press u to undo the last change.
levels.hint: u undoes one change at a time. Press it again to go further back.

levels.title: Redo
levels.brief: Line two was deleted, then the delete was undone. Redo it with Ctrl-r.

levels.title: Move a line
levels.brief: Swap the two lines. dd deletes a line into a register; p puts it back below the cursor.
levels.hint: Deleted text is not lost. p brings it back.

levels.title: Put above
levels.brief: Move the last line to the top. P (capital) puts the register above the cursor.
levels.hint: After dd the cursor is on the last remaining line, so you need to move up twice.

levels.title: New line
levels.brief: Insert the missing line. o opens a new line below the cursor and enters Insert mode.
levels.hint: o is open. Lower case opens below.

levels.title: Line above
levels.brief: Add a title line above. O (capital) opens a line above the cursor.

levels.title: Both ends
levels.brief: Wrap the word in angle brackets. I inserts at the start of the line, A appends at the end.
levels.hint: Two insert sessions: I ... Esc, then A ... Esc.
